lq.q: Analyze the use of symbolic programming in solving calculus problems like differentiation, integration, and limits.
answer: Symbolic programming automates calculus operations without manual steps. Using Sympy:
from sympy import symbols, diff, integrate, limit
d = diff(f, x) i = integrate(f, x) l = limit(1/x, x, float('inf'))
This analysis shows how symbolic tools can solve problems exactly, unlike numerical methods which may involve rounding errors.
